home.title: Business connections and digital marketing
home.subtitle: We connect companies with investors, production sites and suppliers — and we grow your visibility online.

business.title: Business connections
business.subtitle: We introduce companies (B2B) to the right partners to grow and operate.
business.item1_body: We connect businesses with investors looking for solid opportunities.
business.item2_body: We help companies find production sites adapted to their needs.
business.item3_body: We introduce companies to reliable suppliers for their operations.

marketing.title: Digital marketing
marketing.subtitle: Website redesign and online visibility — including on Google and AI assistants.
marketing.item1_body: We rebuild your website so it is clear, modern and ready for business.
marketing.item2_body: We improve your pages so people can find you more easily when they search on Google.
marketing.item3_body: We prepare your content so AI tools (like ChatGPT) can understand your business and mention you in their answers.
marketing.item4_title: Being visible in AI search results
marketing.item4_body: We also work on visibility in new AI search experiences (for example Google’s AI summaries), so your brand appears where customers look today.
